Tightening σ from 0.02 to 0.01 gives z=5, P≈0.00003%, DPMO≈0.3 — almost zero defects, showing that compressing dispersion reduces tail probability exponentially.
map.本工具按上规格（USL）计算超出上限的尾概率；若关心低于下限，应改用下规格公式: This tool computes the upper tail probability beyond the USL; if you care about falling below the LSL, use Φ((μ−LSL)/σ) instead. When both sides exceed and the specification sits far from the mean, the two tail probabilities can be added approximately, but strictly the total probability outside the specification interval should be computed directly.
map.正态分布假设不成立怎么办？: What if the normal distribution assumption fails?
map.实际特性常非严格正态（偏态、厚尾）。此时用正态近似会低估尾概率（厚尾更危险），应: Real characteristics are often not strictly normal (skewed, heavy-tailed). A normal approximation then underestimates tail probability (heavy tails are more dangerous), so run a normality test (e.g. Anderson-Darling) or switch to non-parametric methods / a Box-Cox transform before assessing.
